notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Dimir Aqueduct.
Dimir Aqueduct does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Dimir Aqueduct.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing DImir Aqueduct to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Repeat.
